title: 第五章 博彩 下第六章 监狱风云
content_zh:
虽然所谓三美，自己见都没见全，但毕竟从今天开始，算是自己的人了，而且酒意正酣，提到这所谓三美，这些男子，眼里都是火热垂涎之意。
陆宁心里不免别扭。
他虽然前世今生都是童子，甚至根本没大接触过女人，可大男子主义，比这些唐朝的古人要严重的多，唐朝许多男子眼里，朋友如手足，正妻以外的妾侍、奴婢都是物品，可以传换，可以送人。
而陆宁就觉得，既然在他们眼里，那三个女子是自己的女人，那就和自己老婆差不多，被这王吉一再提起，惹得这些男人们心里不定YY什么呢。
耸耸肩，陆宁蹙眉道：“王参军，还是不要提我的家眷奴婢了吧，本公不喜欢听。”前世熟悉他的人会知道，这是这位可怕人物，要爆发的前兆。
王吉不以为意的笑道：“第下，酒到醉时，不谈论美人，我们又谈论什么呢？”
“可以谈论你老母啊！”陆宁随口说着。
场中，觥筹交错的喧闹声突然就没了，大家都怔怔看着陆宁，这，怎么就骂上大街了。
王吉腾一下拍案而起，脸都气白了，“陆宁！你说甚么？！”气急下直呼姓名，他显然从心里，从没将这个农家少年放在眼里。
对陆宁被封国主，他知道的内容和坊间大多数传闻一样，很模糊，只以为是那周国国主中伏，中乱箭身亡，恰好这农家少年运气好，有一枝箭射中周国国主要害而已。
总归就是，走了狗屎运。
实际上，唐主宣传此次大胜，也是说周国国主中伏身亡，这自然是为了皇家纂承天序的脸面。
王吉，一直心里就酸溜溜的，被这农家少年郎一步登天，得到天大的恩荣，甚至裂土封公，简直就是莫名其妙。
看他裹着狐裘一副随时都可能被一阵风吹死的痨病鬼样子，能立什么军功？
现今被陆宁当头当面辱骂，王吉按捺不住，拍案而起，直呼陆宁的名字。
“王吉，大胆，竟敢直呼第下名姓！”李景爻立时一拍桌子，王吉虽然背景极深，但毕竟是他的同僚下官，这时候他如果不言语，那就是他的不是了，看乔舍人，都在蹙眉。
小国主不讲究是小国主的事情，毕竟听闻小国主是有些暗疾，而作为州属七品官员，竟敢吆喝差了二十多级的县公名姓，这事可大可小，如果闹大了，说不定都要判笞刑，打个几十板子。
更莫说，这位县公是新贵，刚刚打破惯例裂土封国。
王吉脸色阵青阵白，但也知道自己可能会闯下大祸，咬了咬牙，将心里的憋屈强忍住，躬身拱手：“第下，下官一时恼怒，出言无状，请第下恕罪！”心里郁闷的，简直要吐血。
但官大一级都压死人，对面这家伙，高了自己二十多级，心里再瞧不起他也好，礼制在这里，有什么办法？

陆宁倒是一怔，心下好笑，突然体会出这个封建制度的优越性来了。
“算了。”陆宁摆了摆手，举杯笑道：“来来来，喝酒。”
接下来，觥筹交错，但再没人敢将话题引到这位小国主的美妾奴婢身上了，心里都琢磨，看来这位小国主有怪癖，就是那种男人中的醋坛子。
有收集****？既然是他经手过的女子，别人就是谈论都不行的？
乔舍人、李景爻等，都琢磨，回去后，这一点一定要向上官详细禀明，本来两人，就都有代上官观察这位小国主品行性格的任务。
王吉，闷闷的喝酒，酒到杯干，看样子，郁闷的要爆炸。
他突然，猛地一下站起。
李景爻蹙眉看着他，心说你再胡闹，便是你那背后之人如何势大，怕也保不住你！
“酒兴正浓，我为诸君舞剑助兴如何？!”王吉说着，大喝一声，“剑来！”
听得他喊，门外扈从一路小跑而入，单膝跪倒，双手奉上佩剑。
“叮”一声，王吉长剑出鞘，却见剑身清冽如水，便是乔舍人这等真正的文人，也不禁暗道好剑。
李景爻知道，这王吉擅长技击之术，听闻他剑术很是了不起，不过倒是没亲眼见过。
本朝虽然已经开始重文官轻武臣，但很多官员，还是有提三尺剑建功立业的豪气，有崇慕前唐“银鞍照白马，飒沓如流星”的侠士遗风。
王吉手弹长剑，笑道：“剑助酒兴，再来点彩头，我就用我府中两个新罗婢，可有人愿意与我对舞？”长剑在手，看来恢复了自信。
他目光扫过马竼化以及站在一旁那些各个胆突突的本县胥吏，朗声道：“你们可有人与我对赌？”
自没人吭声，东海县的胥吏们，他目光扫到时，都纷纷低头。
“第下，你这东海，没人才啊！”王吉轻蔑的摇了摇头。
陆宁微微蹙眉，虽然自己想低调，可刚刚被封国，明面上又是因为什么劳什子的军功，然后就在这东海国被人欺辱，也太说不过去。
以后自己这国主，还有牌面吗？
笑了笑，“还是王参军的彩头不够吸引人，本县就有新罗坊、新罗村，都是新罗人聚居之地，新罗婢有什么稀奇的？”

陆宁回头看向众胥吏，笑道：“我说的对不对啊！”
有人不敢吭声，但也有胆子大的，难道不拍本国国主，拍你个外来官？
“主君说的是！”
“第下圣明！”
“如果主君下场，一千个王参军也不是主君的对手！一万个新罗婢也赢了！”最后尖着嗓子喊的却是刘汉常，他脸肿得猪头一样，但表忠心全不在乎外来州官的感受，自己的小命要紧，希望国主晚点捏死自己，多苟活几天算几天。
content_en:
Although the so-called three beauties have not been seen by myself, after all, from today on, they are regarded as their own, and they are still drunk. When these so-called three beauties are mentioned, these men's eyes are full of eagerness and covetousness.
Lu Ning felt awkward.
Although he was a boy in his previous life and had never even had much contact with women, his chauvinism was much more serious than that of the ancients of the Tang Dynasty. In the eyes of many men in the Tang Dynasty, friends were like brothers and sisters, and concubines and slaves other than their wives were objects that could be exchanged and given away.
And Lu Ning felt that since in their eyes, those three women were his women, they were similar to his own wives. Wang Ji's repeated mention of them made these men feel uncertain.
Shrugged, Lu Ning frowned and said, "Wang Canjun, please don't mention my family and slaves. I don't like to hear it." People who were familiar with him in his previous life will know that this is a precursor to the outbreak of this terrible person.
Wang Ji smiled nonchalantly and said, "Second, if we don't talk about beauties when we're drunk, what are we going to talk about?"
"We can talk about your mother!" Lu Ning said casually.
In the field, the noise of people drinking and drinking suddenly disappeared. Everyone looked at Lu Ning in bewilderment, wondering why he was scolded on the street.
Wang Jiteng suddenly jumped up and turned pale with anger, "Lu Ning! What did you say?!" He called out his name in anger. It was obvious that he had never taken this young farm boy seriously in his heart.
What he knew about Lu Ning being granted the title of king was as vague as most of the rumors in the market. He only thought that the king of Zhou was ambushed and killed by random arrows. It happened that the young peasant boy was lucky and one of the arrows hit the king of Zhou and killed him.
In short, it was just bad luck.
In fact, when the Tang Dynasty publicized this great victory, it was also said that the Zhou Kingdom's leader was ambushed and died. This was naturally for the sake of the royal compilation of Tianxu.
Wang Ji has always felt sour in his heart. It is simply inexplicable that this young farm boy rose to the top and received such great favors and honors that he even broke the earth and became a prince.
Looking at him wrapped in a fox fur and looking like a consumptive ghost who might be blown to death by a gust of wind at any time, what kind of military exploits can he achieve?
Now that Lu Ning was being insulted to his face, Wang Ji couldn't hold back anymore and got up and called Lu Ning by name.
"Wang Ji, you are so bold, you dare to call the next person by his first name!" Li Jingyao immediately slapped the table. Although Wang Ji had a very deep background, he was still a junior officer of his. If he didn't say anything at this time, it would be his fault. Looking at Qiao She, everyone was frowning.
The little country leader does not pay attention to the matter of the small country leader. After all, I heard that the little country leader has some hidden problems, and as a seventh-level official of the state, he dares to call out the name of the county official who is more than 20 levels behind.
Not to mention, this county official is a new rich man who has just broken the convention and split the country.
Wang Ji's face turned blue and white, but he also knew that he might cause a big disaster. He gritted his teeth and suppressed the grievance in his heart. He bowed and handed over his hands: "I, I was angry for a moment and said something rude. Please forgive me!" He was so depressed that he almost vomited blood.
But the official level is overwhelming. The guy opposite me is more than twenty levels higher than me. No matter how much I despise him, what can I do if the etiquette is here?
Lu Ning was startled, feeling amused, and suddenly realized the superiority of this feudal system.
"Forget it." Lu Ning waved his hand, raised his glass and said with a smile, "Come on, let's drink."
Next, there was a lot of drinking and drinking, but no one dared to bring the topic to the little king's beautiful concubines and slaves. They all thought in their hearts that it seemed that the little king had a weird quirk and was the jealous type among men.
Have you collected ****? Since she is a woman he has dealt with, others can’t even talk about it?
Qiao Sheren, Li Jingyao and others all thought that after returning, they must report this to Shangguan in detail. Originally, they both had to observe the conduct of the little country leader on behalf of Shangguan.Character tasks.
Wang Ji drank in a depressed manner until his glass was dry. It looked like he was so depressed that he was going to explode.
He stood up suddenly.
Li Jingyao frowned and looked at him, thinking that if you keep fooling around, no matter how powerful the person behind you is, they may not be able to protect you!
"We're in the mood for wine, how about I perform a sword dance for you all?!" Wang Ji said and shouted, "Here comes the sword!"
Hearing his shout, the guards outside the door ran all the way in, knelt down on one knee, and held up their swords with both hands.
With a "ding" sound, Wang Ji's long sword was unsheathed, and the blade was as clear as water. Even a true scholar like Qiao Sheren couldn't help but secretly say that the sword is good.
Li Jingyao knew that Wang Ji was good at martial arts and heard that his swordsmanship was amazing, but he had never seen it with his own eyes.
Although this dynasty has begun to value civil servants over military ministers, many officials still have the courage to carry out the three-foot sword and make achievements, and they admire the legacy of the chivalrous people of the former Tang Dynasty who "silver saddles shine on white horses, scurrying like shooting stars."
Wang Ji flicked the long sword in his hand and said with a smile: "The sword will help the wine, and for some bonuses, I will use the two Silla maids in my house. Is there anyone willing to dance with me?" With the long sword in his hand, he seemed to have regained his confidence.
He glanced at Ma Yanhua and the county subordinates who were standing aside, and said loudly: "Is there any one of you who can bet against me?"
Since no one said anything, the subordinate officials in Donghai County all bowed their heads when he glanced at them.
"Secondly, you don't have any talent in Donghai!" Wang Ji shook his head contemptuously.
Lu Ning frowned slightly. Although he wanted to keep a low profile, it was unjustifiable that he had just been sealed off from the country, and it was apparently because of his military exploits, and then he was bullied in the East China Sea Kingdom.
Will I, as the leader of the country, still have any cards to play in the future?
He smiled and said, "Wang Canjun's prize is not attractive enough. This county has Silla Square and Silla Village, both of which are places where Silla people live. What's so strange about Silla maids?"
Lu Ning turned back to look at the subordinates and said with a smile, "What I said is right!"
Some people dare not say anything, but there are also those who are bold. Why don't you pat the leader of your own country and pat you, a foreign official?
"My lord is right!"
"The next sage!"
"If the Lord is defeated, a thousand kings joining the army will not be his opponent! Ten thousand Silla maids will also win!" It was Liu Hanchang who screamed in the end. His face was as swollen as a pig's head, but he showed his loyalty and did not care about the feelings of the foreign governors. His own life was important. He hoped that the Lord would pinch him to death later and live for a few more days.
